hotels.title: Back by Popular Demand: Goulburn Valley Wine Country Luxury with Cellar Door Tasting & Daily Breakfast
hotels.description: Escape to the romance of the Goulburn Valley's prestigious vine-draped hills. Just a scenic 90-minute drive from Melbourne, this stunning architectural gem was envisioned by esteemed designer Hecker Guthrie. Here, your rural retreat awaits, seamlessly blending rustic charm with contemporary elegance, offering the full winery experience right on your doorstep. Each private sanctuary boasts a harmonious fusion of natural hues and lavish modern comforts, as well as panoramic vistas of the estate's vineyards or the sweeping valley. Relax in pure sophistication at the Mitchelton Wines Cellar Door, just steps from your accommodation. Take a dip in the 20-metre infinity pool and dine at The Muse Restaurant, offering modern farmhouse cuisine. Enveloped by 280 acres of vineyards and native bushland, The Mitchelton Hotel Nagambie offers the opportunity to indulge in highly sought after luxuries, all while soaking up serene natural surroundings.
